ARM64 Instruction Evaluation Semantics (Arm64.Eval)

  • Layer / Role: Arm64 Trusted Computing Base (Role::Spec, definitions only, 0 theorems).

  • Purpose & Key Exports: Architectural execution semantics for single AArch64 A64 instructions (execInstWithSvc, noSyscalls; execInst re-exported in Arm64.Trusted.ISA.Semantics), arithmetic/flag helpers (AddWithCarry32, AddWithCarry64, ConditionHolds), addressing and bitfield evaluators (evalAddrMode, evalBitfield), and AES round primitives (aesSBoxTable, aesInvSBoxTable, evalAesOp). Modeled Linux svc #0 syscall families live in Arm64/Trusted/Syscalls/.

  • When to read: Use lean-sig outline Arm64/Trusted/ISA/Eval.lean or ProofLib/Eval.lean / WP.lean during proofs (wp_steps reduces execInst automatically); read specific lines here only when auditing or extending instruction execution semantics.

def AddWithCarry32L37–47 ↗#

32-bit AddWithCarry: returns (result, PState) with exact architectural NZCV flags.

def AddWithCarry32 (x y : BitVec 32) (carryIn : Bool) : BitVec 32 × PState := let cin : BitVec 33 := if carryIn then 1#33 else 0#33 let usum : BitVec 33 := cin + (y.zeroExtend 33 + x.zeroExtend 33) let ssum : BitVec 33 := cin + (y.signExtend 33 + x.signExtend 33) let res : BitVec 32 := usum.truncate 32 let n := res.msb let z := res == 0#32 let c := usum.msb let v := ssum.msb != res.msb (res, { n, z, c, v })

def AddWithCarry64L49–59 ↗#

64-bit AddWithCarry: returns (result, PState) with exact architectural NZCV flags.

def AddWithCarry64 (x y : BitVec 64) (carryIn : Bool) : BitVec 64 × PState := let cin : BitVec 65 := if carryIn then 1#65 else 0#65 let usum : BitVec 65 := cin + (y.zeroExtend 65 + x.zeroExtend 65) let ssum : BitVec 65 := cin + (y.signExtend 65 + x.signExtend 65) let res : BitVec 64 := usum.truncate 64 let n := res.msb let z := res == 0#64 let c := usum.msb let v := ssum.msb != res.msb (res, { n, z, c, v })

def ConditionHoldsL61–79 ↗#

Evaluate whether a condition code cond holds in processor state ps (ConditionHolds in ARM ASL).

def ConditionHolds (cond : CondCode) (ps : PState) : Bool := match cond with | .EQ => ps.z | .NE => !ps.z | .CS => ps.c | .CC => !ps.c | .MI => ps.n | .PL => !ps.n | .VS => ps.v | .VC => !ps.v | .HI => ps.c && !ps.z | .LS => !(ps.c && !ps.z) | .GE => ps.n == ps.v | .LT => ps.n != ps.v | .GT => !ps.z && (ps.n == ps.v) | .LE => !(!ps.z && (ps.n == ps.v)) | .AL => true | .NV => true

def shift32L81–88 ↗#

Shift a 32-bit value by amount (0..31).

def shift32 (val : BitVec 32) (op : ShiftType) (amount : Nat) : BitVec 32 := let amt := amount % 32 match op with | .LSL => val <<< amt | .LSR => val >>> amt | .ASR => val.sshiftRight amt | .ROR => val.rotateRight amt

def shift64L90–97 ↗#

Shift a 64-bit value by amount (0..63).

def shift64 (val : BitVec 64) (op : ShiftType) (amount : Nat) : BitVec 64 := let amt := amount % 64 match op with | .LSL => val <<< amt | .LSR => val >>> amt | .ASR => val.sshiftRight amt | .ROR => val.rotateRight amt

def shiftValL99–103 ↗#

Shift a register value at width w.

def shiftVal (w : Width) (val : BitVec 64) (op : ShiftType) (amount : Nat) : BitVec 64 := match w with | .W32 => (shift32 (val.truncate 32) op amount).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => shift64 val op amount

def extendValL105–120 ↗#

Sign- or zero-extend a value according to ExtendType and shift left by amount.

def extendVal (w : Width) (val : BitVec 64) (ext : ExtendType) (amount : Nat) : BitVec 64 := let ext64 : BitVec 64 := match ext with | .UXTB => (val.truncate 8).zeroExtend 64 | .UXTH => (val.truncate 16).zeroExtend 64 | .UXTW => (val.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .UXTX => val | .SXTB => (val.truncate 8).signExtend 64 | .SXTH => (val.truncate 16).signExtend 64 | .SXTW => (val.truncate 32).signExtend 64 | .SXTX => val let shifted := ext64 <<< amount match w with | .W32 => (shifted.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => shifted

def evalAddSubL122–136 ↗#

Evaluate an AddSubOp (ADD, ADDS, SUB, SUBS) on operands x, y at width w.

def evalAddSub (w : Width) (op : AddSubOp) (x y : BitVec 64) (carryIn : Option Bool := none) : BitVec 64 × Option PState := let isSub := match op with | .SUB | .SUBS => true | .ADD | .ADDS => false let setFlags := match op with | .ADDS | .SUBS => true | .ADD | .SUB => false let cIn := match carryIn with | some c => c | none => isSub match w with | .W32 => let x32 := x.truncate 32 let y32 := if isSub then ~~~(y.truncate 32) else y.truncate 32 let (res32, ps) := AddWithCarry32 x32 y32 cIn (res32.zeroExtend 64, if setFlags then some ps else none) | .W64 => let y64 := if isSub then ~~~y else y let (res64, ps) := AddWithCarry64 x y64 cIn (res64, if setFlags then some ps else none)

def evalLogicalL138–156 ↗#

Evaluate a LogicalOp (AND, BIC, ORR, ORN, EOR, EON, ANDS, BICS) at width w.

def evalLogical (w : Width) (op : LogicalOp) (x y : BitVec 64) (psOld : PState) : BitVec 64 × Option PState := let yMod := match op with | .BIC | .ORN | .EON | .BICS => ~~~y | _ => y let raw := match op with | .AND | .BIC | .ANDS | .BICS => x &&& yMod | .ORR | .ORN => x ||| yMod | .EOR | .EON => x ^^^ yMod let setFlags := match op with | .ANDS | .BICS => true | _ => false match w with | .W32 => let res32 := raw.truncate 32 let ps : PState := { n := res32.msb, z := res32 == 0#32, c := false, v := false } let _ := psOld (res32.zeroExtend 64, if setFlags then some ps else none) | .W64 => let ps : PState := { n := raw.msb, z := raw == 0#64, c := false, v := false } (raw, if setFlags then some ps else none)

def evalBitfieldL158–205 ↗#

Evaluate SBFM, BFM, UBFM bitfield move instruction at width w.

def evalBitfield (w : Width) (op : BitfieldOp) (dst src : BitVec 64) (immr imms : Nat) : BitVec 64 := let N : Nat := match w with | .W32 => 32 | .W64 => 64 let srcW : BitVec 64 := match w with | .W32 => (src.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => src let dstW : BitVec 64 := match w with | .W32 => (dst.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => dst let immr := immr % N let imms := imms % N -- Fast path for standard LSR, ASR, LSL encodings so symbolic execution stays compact if op == .UBFM && imms + 1 == N then let res := srcW >>> immr match w with | .W32 => (res.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => res else if op == .SBFM && imms + 1 == N then let res := match w with | .W32 => ((src.truncate 32).sshiftRight immr).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => src.sshiftRight immr res else if op == .UBFM && immr > imms && imms + 1 == immr then let shift := N - immr let res := srcW <<< shift match w with | .W32 => (res.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => res else let res64 : BitVec 64 := if imms >= immr then let len := imms - immr + 1 let fieldMask : BitVec 64 := BitVec.ofNat 64 (Nat.shiftLeft 1 len - 1) let extracted := (srcW >>> immr) &&& fieldMask match op with | .UBFM => extracted | .SBFM => let signFill : BitVec 64 := if srcW.getLsbD imms then 0xffffffffffffffff#64 else 0#64 extracted ||| (signFill &&& ~~~fieldMask) | .BFM => (dstW &&& ~~~fieldMask) ||| extracted else let len := imms + 1 let pos := N - immr let lowMask : BitVec 64 := BitVec.ofNat 64 (Nat.shiftLeft 1 len - 1) let fieldMask : BitVec 64 := lowMask <<< pos let positioned := (srcW &&& lowMask) <<< pos match op with | .UBFM => positioned | .SBFM => let signFill : BitVec 64 := if srcW.getLsbD imms then 0xffffffffffffffff#64 else 0#64 let topMask : BitVec 64 := if pos + len >= 64 then 0#64 else ~~~(BitVec.ofNat 64 (Nat.shiftLeft 1 (pos + len) - 1)) positioned ||| (signFill &&& topMask) | .BFM => (dstW &&& ~~~fieldMask) ||| positioned match w with | .W32 => (res64.truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => res64

def countLeadingZerosL207–215 ↗#

Count leading zeros in an n-bit bitvector.

def countLeadingZeros {n : Nat} (bv : BitVec n) : Nat := let rec loop (k : Nat) : Nat := match k with | 0 => n | k' + 1 => if bv.getLsbD k' then n - 1 - k' else loop k' loop n

def countLeadingSignsL217–228 ↗#

Count leading sign bits (number of bits following MSB that equal MSB) in an n-bit bitvector.

def countLeadingSigns {n : Nat} (bv : BitVec n) : Nat := if n <= 1 then 0 else let sign := bv.msb let rec loop (k : Nat) : Nat := match k with | 0 => n - 1 | k' + 1 => if bv.getLsbD k' != sign then (n - 1) - 1 - k' else loop k' loop (n - 1)

def reverseBitsL230–237 ↗#

Reverse all bits in an n-bit bitvector.

def reverseBits {n : Nat} (bv : BitVec n) : BitVec n := Id.run do let mut acc : BitVec n := 0 for i in [0:n] do if bv.getLsbD i then acc := acc ||| (BitVec.ofNat n 1 <<< (n - 1 - i)) return acc

def rev16_64L239–249 ↗#

Reverse bytes within each 16-bit halfword of a 64-bit value (REV16).

def rev16_64 (v : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 := let b0 := v.extractLsb' 0 8 let b1 := v.extractLsb' 8 8 let b2 := v.extractLsb' 16 8 let b3 := v.extractLsb' 24 8 let b4 := v.extractLsb' 32 8 let b5 := v.extractLsb' 40 8 let b6 := v.extractLsb' 48 8 let b7 := v.extractLsb' 56 8 b6 ++ b7 ++ b4 ++ b5 ++ b2 ++ b3 ++ b0 ++ b1

def rev32_64L251–261 ↗#

Reverse bytes within each 32-bit word of a 64-bit value (REV32).

def rev32_64 (v : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 := let b0 := v.extractLsb' 0 8 let b1 := v.extractLsb' 8 8 let b2 := v.extractLsb' 16 8 let b3 := v.extractLsb' 24 8 let b4 := v.extractLsb' 32 8 let b5 := v.extractLsb' 40 8 let b6 := v.extractLsb' 48 8 let b7 := v.extractLsb' 56 8 b4 ++ b5 ++ b6 ++ b7 ++ b0 ++ b1 ++ b2 ++ b3

def rev64L263–273 ↗#

Reverse all 8 bytes of a 64-bit value (REV / REV64).

def rev64 (v : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 := let b0 := v.extractLsb' 0 8 let b1 := v.extractLsb' 8 8 let b2 := v.extractLsb' 16 8 let b3 := v.extractLsb' 24 8 let b4 := v.extractLsb' 32 8 let b5 := v.extractLsb' 40 8 let b6 := v.extractLsb' 48 8 let b7 := v.extractLsb' 56 8 b0 ++ b1 ++ b2 ++ b3 ++ b4 ++ b5 ++ b6 ++ b7

def checkRegSPAlignedL281–288 ↗#

Architectural CheckSPAlignment() check for a base register r: if r = .sp, then s.spAligned ((s.sp &&& 0b1111#64) == 0#64) must hold. Structured ASL: arm-asl-extract query CheckSPAlignment (shared_pseudocode.xml). See ARM Architecture Reference Manual Section D1.4.10.

-- https://developer.arm.com/documentation/ddi0487/latest/-Part-D-The-AArch64-System-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-D1-The-AArch64-System-Level-Programmers--Model/-D1-4-Exceptions/-D1-4-10-Program-Counter-and-stack-pointer-alignment @[inline] def checkRegSPAligned (s : State) (r : Reg) : Bool := match r with | .sp => s.spAligned | _ => true

def checkAddrSPAlignedL290–293 ↗#

Architectural CheckSPAlignment() check for an AddrMode: if addr.baseReg = .sp, then s.spAligned must hold.

@[inline] def checkAddrSPAligned (s : State) (addr : AddrMode) : Bool := checkRegSPAligned s addr.baseReg

def MemWidth.isAlignedL296–305 ↗#

Architectural natural-alignment check for MemWidth (IsAligned(address, size) in ARMv8-A): required by load-acquire (LDAR*), store-release (STLR*), and load/store-exclusive (LDXR*/LDAXR*/STXR*/STLXR*) instructions even when SCTLR_EL1.A == 0. See ARM Architecture Reference Manual Section B2.8.2: Alignment of data accesses.

-- https://developer.arm.com/documentation/ddi0487/latest/-Part-B-The-AArch64-Application-Level-Architecture/-Chapter-B2-The-AArch64-Application-Level-Memory-Model/-B2-8-Alignment-support/-B2-8-2-Alignment-of-data-accesses @[inline] def MemWidth.isAligned (sz : MemWidth) (ea : BitVec 64) : Bool := match sz with | .B8 => true | .H16 => (ea &&& 0b1#64) == 0#64 | .W32 => (ea &&& 0b11#64) == 0#64 | .X64 => (ea &&& 0b111#64) == 0#64

def evalAddrModeL307–323 ↗#

Compute effective memory address and optional post-access base register value for AddrMode.

def evalAddrMode (s : State) (addr : AddrMode) : BitVec 64 × Option (Reg × BitVec 64) := match addr with | .Offset base off => (s.readReg64 base + off, none) | .UnscaledOffset base off => (s.readReg64 base + off, none) | .PreIndex base off => let ea := s.readReg64 base + off (ea, some (base, ea)) | .PostIndex base off => let baseVal := s.readReg64 base (baseVal, some (base, baseVal + off)) | .RegOffset base index ext amount => let baseVal := s.readReg64 base let idxVal := extendVal .W64 (s.readReg64 index) ext amount (baseVal + idxVal, none)

def getSimdLaneL329–331 ↗#

Extract an esize-bit lane at idx from a 128-bit vector.

def getSimdLane (v : BitVec 128) (esize : Nat) (idx : Nat) : BitVec 128 := (v >>> (idx * esize)) &&& ((1#128 <<< esize) - 1#128)

def mapSimdLanesL333–344 ↗#

Apply a unary lane-wise function across numLanes lanes of esize bits.

def mapSimdLanes (q : Bool) (esize : Nat) (v : BitVec 128) (f : BitVec 128 → BitVec 128) : BitVec 128 := let totalBits := if q then 128 else 64 let numLanes := totalBits / esize let mask : BitVec 128 := (1#128 <<< esize) - 1#128 Id.run do let mut acc : BitVec 128 := 0#128 for i in [0:numLanes] do let lane := (v >>> (i * esize)) &&& mask let outLane := (f lane) &&& mask acc := acc ||| (outLane <<< (i * esize)) return acc

def zipSimdLanesL346–358 ↗#

Apply a binary lane-wise function across numLanes lanes of esize bits.

def zipSimdLanes (q : Bool) (esize : Nat) (vn vm : BitVec 128) (f : BitVec 128 → BitVec 128 → BitVec 128) : BitVec 128 := let totalBits := if q then 128 else 64 let numLanes := totalBits / esize let mask : BitVec 128 := (1#128 <<< esize) - 1#128 Id.run do let mut acc : BitVec 128 := 0#128 for i in [0:numLanes] do let a := (vn >>> (i * esize)) &&& mask let b := (vm >>> (i * esize)) &&& mask let outLane := (f a b) &&& mask acc := acc ||| (outLane <<< (i * esize)) return acc

def gfMulL400–413 ↗#

Multiply in GF(2^8) modulo x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x + 1.

def gfMul (a b : UInt8) : UInt8 := Id.run do let mut p : UInt8 := 0 let mut x : UInt8 := a let mut y : UInt8 := b for _ in [0:8] do if (y &&& 1) != 0 then p := p ^^^ x let hi := (x &&& 0x80) != 0 x := x <<< 1 if hi then x := x ^^^ 0x1b y := y >>> 1 return p

def evalAesOpL415–465 ↗#

Evaluate ARMv8 AESE, AESD, AESMC, AESIMC on 128-bit blocks.

def evalAesOp (op : AesOp) (vd vn : BitVec 128) : BitVec 128 := Id.run do let getByte (v : BitVec 128) (i : Nat) : UInt8 := UInt8.ofNat ((v >>> (i * 8)).truncate 8).toNat let packBytes (bs : Array UInt8) : BitVec 128 := Id.run do let mut acc : BitVec 128 := 0#128 for i in [0:16] do let b : BitVec 128 := BitVec.ofNat 128 bs[i]!.toNat acc := acc ||| (b <<< (i * 8)) return acc match op with | .AESE => let x := vd ^^^ vn let perm : Array Nat := #[0, 5, 10, 15, 4, 9, 14, 3, 8, 13, 2, 7, 12, 1, 6, 11] let mut out : Array UInt8 := Array.mkEmpty 16 for i in [0:16] do let b := getByte x perm[i]! out := out.push (aesSBoxTable[b.toNat]!) return packBytes out | .AESD => let x := vd ^^^ vn let perm : Array Nat := #[0, 13, 10, 7, 4, 1, 14, 11, 8, 5, 2, 15, 12, 9, 6, 3] let mut out : Array UInt8 := Array.mkEmpty 16 for i in [0:16] do let b := getByte x perm[i]! out := out.push (aesInvSBoxTable[b.toNat]!) return packBytes out | .AESMC => let mut out : Array UInt8 := Array.mkEmpty 16 for c in [0:4] do let s0 := getByte vn (4 * c) let s1 := getByte vn (4 * c + 1) let s2 := getByte vn (4 * c + 2) let s3 := getByte vn (4 * c + 3) out := out.push (gfMul 2 s0 ^^^ gfMul 3 s1 ^^^ s2 ^^^ s3) out := out.push (s0 ^^^ gfMul 2 s1 ^^^ gfMul 3 s2 ^^^ s3) out := out.push (s0 ^^^ s1 ^^^ gfMul 2 s2 ^^^ gfMul 3 s3) out := out.push (gfMul 3 s0 ^^^ s1 ^^^ s2 ^^^ gfMul 2 s3) return packBytes out | .AESIMC => let mut out : Array UInt8 := Array.mkEmpty 16 for c in [0:4] do let s0 := getByte vn (4 * c) let s1 := getByte vn (4 * c + 1) let s2 := getByte vn (4 * c + 2) let s3 := getByte vn (4 * c + 3) out := out.push (gfMul 0x0e s0 ^^^ gfMul 0x0b s1 ^^^ gfMul 0x0d s2 ^^^ gfMul 0x09 s3) out := out.push (gfMul 0x09 s0 ^^^ gfMul 0x0e s1 ^^^ gfMul 0x0b s2 ^^^ gfMul 0x0d s3) out := out.push (gfMul 0x0d s0 ^^^ gfMul 0x09 s1 ^^^ gfMul 0x0e s2 ^^^ gfMul 0x0b s3) out := out.push (gfMul 0x0b s0 ^^^ gfMul 0x0d s1 ^^^ gfMul 0x09 s2 ^^^ gfMul 0x0e s3) return packBytes out

def vfpExpandImm32L467–473 ↗#

Expand an 8-bit ARMv8 floating-point immediate (VFPExpandImm) to IEEE-754 binary32.

def vfpExpandImm32 (imm8 : BitVec 8) : BitVec 32 := let sign : BitVec 1 := imm8.extractLsb' 7 1 let notB6 : BitVec 1 := ~~~(imm8.extractLsb' 6 1) let repB6 : BitVec 5 := if imm8.getLsbD 6 then 0b11111#5 else 0b00000#5 let rest : BitVec 6 := imm8.extractLsb' 0 6 sign ++ notB6 ++ repB6 ++ rest ++ 0#19

def vfpExpandImm64L475–481 ↗#

Expand an 8-bit ARMv8 floating-point immediate (VFPExpandImm) to IEEE-754 binary64.

def vfpExpandImm64 (imm8 : BitVec 8) : BitVec 64 := let sign : BitVec 1 := imm8.extractLsb' 7 1 let notB6 : BitVec 1 := ~~~(imm8.extractLsb' 6 1) let repB6 : BitVec 8 := if imm8.getLsbD 6 then 0xff#8 else 0x00#8 let rest : BitVec 6 := imm8.extractLsb' 0 6 sign ++ notB6 ++ repB6 ++ rest ++ 0#48

Instruction Execution Helpers

def execAddSubImmL487–494 ↗#

Execute an add/subtract (immediate) operation (ADD, ADDS, SUB, SUBS).

@[simp, reducible] def execAddSubImm (w : Width) (op : AddSubOp) (rd rn : Reg) (imm12 : BitVec 12) (shift12 : Bool) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let imm : BitVec 64 := if shift12 then (imm12.zeroExtend 64) <<< 12 else imm12.zeroExtend 64 let (res, optPs) := evalAddSub w op x imm none let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execAddSubExtL496–503 ↗#

Execute an add/subtract (extended register) operation (ADD, ADDS, SUB, SUBS).

@[simp, reducible] def execAddSubExt (w : Width) (op : AddSubOp) (rd rn rm : Reg) (ext : ExtendType) (amount : Nat) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let y := extendVal w (s.readReg64 rm) ext amount let (res, optPs) := evalAddSub w op x y none let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execAddSubShiftL505–512 ↗#

Execute an add/subtract (shifted register) operation (ADD, ADDS, SUB, SUBS).

@[simp, reducible] def execAddSubShift (w : Width) (op : AddSubOp) (rd rn rm : Reg) (shift : ShiftType) (amount : Nat) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let y := shiftVal w (s.readReg w rm) shift amount let (res, optPs) := evalAddSub w op x y none let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execAddSubCarryL514–521 ↗#

Execute an ADC / ADCS / SBC / SBCS operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execAddSubCarry (w : Width) (op : AddSubOp) (rd rn rm : Reg) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let y := s.readReg w rm let (res, optPs) := evalAddSub w op x y (some s.pstate.c) let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execLogicalImmL523–529 ↗#

Execute a logical (immediate) operation (AND, ORR, EOR, ANDS).

@[simp, reducible] def execLogicalImm (w : Width) (op : LogicalOp) (rd rn : Reg) (mask : BitVec 64) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let (res, optPs) := evalLogical w op x mask s.pstate let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execLogicalShiftL531–538 ↗#

Execute a logical (shifted register) operation (AND, BIC, ORR, ORN, EOR, EON, ANDS, BICS).

@[simp, reducible] def execLogicalShift (w : Width) (op : LogicalOp) (rd rn rm : Reg) (shift : ShiftType) (amount : Nat) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let y := shiftVal w (s.readReg w rm) shift amount let (res, optPs) := evalLogical w op x y s.pstate let s1 := s.writeReg w rd res let s2 := match optPs with | some ps => s1.setPState ps | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execMoveWideL540–551 ↗#

Execute a move wide (MOVZ, MOVN, MOVK) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execMoveWide (w : Width) (op : MoveWideOp) (rd : Reg) (imm16 : BitVec 16) (hw : Nat) (s : State) : State := let shifted : BitVec 64 := (imm16.zeroExtend 64) <<< hw let res : BitVec 64 := match op with | .MOVZ => shifted | .MOVN => ~~~shifted | .MOVK => let old := s.readReg w rd let clearMask := ~~~(0xffff#64 <<< hw) (old &&& clearMask) ||| shifted (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execBitfieldL553–558 ↗#

Execute a bitfield move (SBFM, BFM, UBFM) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execBitfield (w : Width) (op : BitfieldOp) (rd rn : Reg) (immr imms : Nat) (s : State) : State := let dst := s.readReg w rd let src := s.readReg w rn let res := evalBitfield w op dst src immr imms (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execCondSelectL560–573 ↗#

Execute a conditional select (CSEL, CSINC, CSINV, CSNEG) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execCondSelect (w : Width) (op : CondSelectOp) (rd rn rm : Reg) (cond : CondCode) (s : State) : State := let holds := ConditionHolds cond s.pstate let res : BitVec 64 := if holds then s.readReg w rn else let mVal := s.readReg w rm match op with | .CSEL => mVal | .CSINC => mVal + 1#64 | .CSINV => ~~~mVal | .CSNEG => 0#64 - mVal (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execCondCompareL575–586 ↗#

Execute a conditional compare (CCMP, CCMN) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execCondCompare (w : Width) (isSub : Bool) (isImm : Bool) (rn : Reg) (rhs : BitVec 64) (rm : Reg) (nzcv : BitVec 4) (cond : CondCode) (s : State) : State := if ConditionHolds cond s.pstate then let x := s.readReg w rn let y := if isImm then rhs else s.readReg w rm let op : AddSubOp := if isSub then .SUBS else .ADDS let (_, optPs) := evalAddSub w op x y none let s1 := match optPs with | some ps => s.setPState ps | none => s s1.advancePC else (s.setPState (PState.ofBits4 nzcv)).advancePC

def execDataProc1L588–605 ↗#

Execute a 1-source data processing (RBIT, REV16, REV32, REV, CLZ, CLS) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execDataProc1 (w : Width) (op : DataProc1Op) (rd rn : Reg) (s : State) : State := let v := s.readReg w rn let res : BitVec 64 := match w, op with | .W32, .RBIT => (reverseBits (v.truncate 32)).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .RBIT => reverseBits v | .W32, .REV16 => ((rev16_64 v).truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .REV16 => rev16_64 v | .W32, .REV32 => ((rev32_64 v).truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .REV32 => rev32_64 v | .W32, .REV => ((rev32_64 v).truncate 32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .REV => rev64 v | .W32, .CLZ => BitVec.ofNat 64 (countLeadingZeros (v.truncate 32)) | .W64, .CLZ => BitVec.ofNat 64 (countLeadingZeros v) | .W32, .CLS => BitVec.ofNat 64 (countLeadingSigns (v.truncate 32)) | .W64, .CLS => BitVec.ofNat 64 (countLeadingSigns v) (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execDataProc2L607–633 ↗#

Execute a 2-source data processing (UDIV, SDIV, LSLV, LSRV, ASRV, RORV) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execDataProc2 (w : Width) (op : DataProc2Op) (rd rn rm : Reg) (s : State) : State := let x := s.readReg w rn let y := s.readReg w rm let res : BitVec 64 := match w, op with | .W32, .UDIV => let x32 := x.truncate 32 let y32 := y.truncate 32 (if y32 == 0#32 then 0#32 else x32 / y32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .UDIV => if y == 0#64 then 0#64 else x / y | .W32, .SDIV => let x32 := x.truncate 32 let y32 := y.truncate 32 (if y32 == 0#32 then 0#32 else BitVec.sdiv x32 y32).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .SDIV => if y == 0#64 then 0#64 else BitVec.sdiv x y | .W32, .LSLV => (shift32 (x.truncate 32) .LSL (y.truncate 32).toNat).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .LSLV => shift64 x .LSL y.toNat | .W32, .LSRV => (shift32 (x.truncate 32) .LSR (y.truncate 32).toNat).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .LSRV => shift64 x .LSR y.toNat | .W32, .ASRV => (shift32 (x.truncate 32) .ASR (y.truncate 32).toNat).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .ASRV => shift64 x .ASR y.toNat | .W32, .RORV => (shift32 (x.truncate 32) .ROR (y.truncate 32).toNat).zeroExtend 64 | .W64, .RORV => shift64 x .ROR y.toNat (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execDataProc3L635–671 ↗#

Execute a 3-source multiply-accumulate (MADD, MSUB, SMADDL, SMSUBL, SMULH, UMADDL, UMSUBL, UMULH) operation.

@[simp, reducible] def execDataProc3 (w : Width) (op : DataProc3Op) (rd rn rm ra : Reg) (s : State) : State := let res : BitVec 64 := match op with | .MADD => match w with | .W32 => ((s.readReg32 ra) + (s.readReg32 rn) * (s.readReg32 rm)).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => (s.readReg64 ra) + (s.readReg64 rn) * (s.readReg64 rm) | .MSUB => match w with | .W32 => ((s.readReg32 ra) - (s.readReg32 rn) * (s.readReg32 rm)).zeroExtend 64 | .W64 => (s.readReg64 ra) - (s.readReg64 rn) * (s.readReg64 rm) | .SMADDL => let n64 := (s.readReg32 rn).signExtend 64 let m64 := (s.readReg32 rm).signExtend 64 (s.readReg64 ra) + n64 * m64 | .SMSUBL => let n64 := (s.readReg32 rn).signExtend 64 let m64 := (s.readReg32 rm).signExtend 64 (s.readReg64 ra) - n64 * m64 | .UMADDL => let n64 := (s.readReg32 rn).zeroExtend 64 let m64 := (s.readReg32 rm).zeroExtend 64 (s.readReg64 ra) + n64 * m64 | .UMSUBL => let n64 := (s.readReg32 rn).zeroExtend 64 let m64 := (s.readReg32 rm).zeroExtend 64 (s.readReg64 ra) - n64 * m64 | .SMULH => let n128 := (s.readReg64 rn).signExtend 128 let m128 := (s.readReg64 rm).signExtend 128 ((n128 * m128) >>> 64).truncate 64 | .UMULH => let n128 := (s.readReg64 rn).zeroExtend 128 let m128 := (s.readReg64 rm).zeroExtend 128 ((n128 * m128) >>> 64).truncate 64 (s.writeReg w rd res).advancePC

def execLdrL673–684 ↗#

Execute a single-register load (LDR, LDUR, LDRB, LDURB, LDRSB, LDURSB, LDRH, LDURH, LDRSH, LDURSH, LDRSW, LDURSW).

@[simp, reducible] def execLdr (w : Width) (size : MemWidth) (signed : Bool) (rt : Reg) (addr : AddrMode) (s : State) : State := if !checkAddrSPAligned s addr then s.setStatus (.Exception "SP alignment fault") else let (ea, wb) := evalAddrMode s addr if !s.mem.canRead ea size.bytes then s.setStatus (.Exception "permission fault") else let val := s.mem.readSized size signed ea let s1 := match wb with | some (base, newBase) => s.writeReg64 base newBase | none => s (s1.writeReg w rt val).advancePC

def execLdrLitL686–693 ↗#

Execute a PC-relative literal load (LDR (literal), LDRSW (literal)).

@[simp, reducible] def execLdrLit (w : Width) (size : MemWidth) (signed : Bool) (rt : Reg) (offset : BitVec 64) (s : State) : State := let ea := s.pc + offset if !s.mem.canRead ea size.bytes then s.setStatus (.Exception "permission fault") else let val := s.mem.readSized size signed ea (s.writeReg w rt val).advancePC

def execStrL695–707 ↗#

Execute a single-register store (STR, STUR, STRB, STURB, STRH, STURH).

@[simp, reducible] def execStr (size : MemWidth) (rt : Reg) (addr : AddrMode) (s : State) : State := if !checkAddrSPAligned s addr then s.setStatus (.Exception "SP alignment fault") else let (ea, wb) := evalAddrMode s addr if !s.mem.canWrite ea size.bytes then s.setStatus (.Exception "permission fault") else let val := s.readReg64 rt let s1 := s.setMem (s.mem.writeSized size ea val) let s2 := match wb with | some (base, newBase) => s1.writeReg64 base newBase | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def execLdpL709–726 ↗#

Execute a register-pair load (LDP, LDPSW). Each element's range is checked separately.

@[simp, reducible] def execLdp (w : Width) (signed : Bool) (rt1 rt2 : Reg) (addr : AddrMode) (s : State) : State := if !checkAddrSPAligned s addr then s.setStatus (.Exception "SP alignment fault") else let (ea, wb) := evalAddrMode s addr let stepBytes : BitVec 64 := if signed then 4#64 else match w with | .W32 => 4#64 | .W64 => 8#64 let sz : MemWidth := if signed then .W32 else match w with | .W32 => .W32 | .W64 => .X64 if !(s.mem.canRead ea sz.bytes && s.mem.canRead (ea + stepBytes) sz.bytes) then s.setStatus (.Exception "permission fault") else let v1 := s.mem.readSized sz signed ea let v2 := s.mem.readSized sz signed (ea + stepBytes) let outW : Width := if signed then .W64 else w let s1 := match wb with | some (base, newBase) => s.writeReg64 base newBase | none => s let s2 := s1.writeReg outW rt1 v1 let s3 := s2.writeReg outW rt2 v2 s3.advancePC

def execStpL728–745 ↗#

Execute a register-pair store (STP). Each element's range is checked separately.

@[simp, reducible] def execStp (w : Width) (rt1 rt2 : Reg) (addr : AddrMode) (s : State) : State := if !checkAddrSPAligned s addr then s.setStatus (.Exception "SP alignment fault") else let (ea, wb) := evalAddrMode s addr let stepBytes : BitVec 64 := match w with | .W32 => 4#64 | .W64 => 8#64 let sz : MemWidth := match w with | .W32 => .W32 | .W64 => .X64 if !(s.mem.canWrite ea sz.bytes && s.mem.canWrite (ea + stepBytes) sz.bytes) then s.setStatus (.Exception "permission fault") else let v1 := s.readReg64 rt1 let v2 := s.readReg64 rt2 let m1 := s.mem.writeSized sz ea v1 let m2 := m1.writeSized sz (ea + stepBytes) v2 let s1 := s.setMem m2 let s2 := match wb with | some (base, newBase) => s1.writeReg64 base newBase | none => s1 s2.advancePC

def evalAtomicOpL747–767 ↗#

LSE atomic new := op(old, rs) at access width sz (inputs/result masked to sz; signed min/max compare the sz-bit two's-complement values). ASL MemAtomic / AArch64.MemAtomic.

def evalAtomicOp (op : AtomicOp) (sz : MemWidth) (old rs : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 := let bits := sz.bytes * 8 let mask : BitVec 64 := if bits ≥ 64 then BitVec.allOnes 64 else (1#64 <<< bits) - 1#64 let a := old &&& mask let b := rs &&& mask let signBit : BitVec 64 := 1#64 <<< (bits - 1) let sLt (x y : BitVec 64) : Bool := BitVec.ult (x ^^^ signBit) (y ^^^ signBit) let res : BitVec 64 := match op with | .ADD => a + b | .CLR => a &&& ~~~b | .EOR => a ^^^ b | .SET => a ||| b | .SMAX => if sLt a b then b else a | .SMIN => if sLt b a then b else a | .UMAX => if BitVec.ult a b then b else a | .UMIN => if BitVec.ult b a then b else a | .SWP => b res &&& mask

def poly32Mod2L769–777 ↗#

ASL Poly32Mod2(data<n-1:0>, poly) (polynomial division over GF(2)), with data held in the low n ≤ 96 bits of a 96-bit vector.

def poly32Mod2 (n : Nat) (data : BitVec 96) (poly : BitVec 32) : BitVec 32 := Id.run do let mut d := data for j in [0:n - 32] do let i := n - 1 - j if d.getLsbD i then d := d ^^^ ((poly.zeroExtend 96) <<< (i - 32)) return d.truncate 32

def evalCrc32L779–787 ↗#

CRC32{B,H,W,X} (c = false, poly 0x04C11DB7) / CRC32C* (c = true, poly 0x1EDC6F41): ASL BitReverse(Poly32Mod2(BitReverse(acc):Zeros(size) EOR BitReverse(val<size-1:0>):Zeros(32), poly)).

def evalCrc32 (c : Bool) (sz : MemWidth) (acc : BitVec 32) (val : BitVec 64) : BitVec 32 := let size := sz.bytes * 8 let poly : BitVec 32 := if c then 0x1EDC6F41#32 else 0x04C11DB7#32 let tempacc : BitVec 96 := ((reverseBits acc).zeroExtend 96) <<< size let revVal : BitVec 64 := (reverseBits val) >>> (64 - size) let tempval : BitVec 96 := (revVal.zeroExtend 96) <<< 32 reverseBits (poly32Mod2 (size + 32) (tempacc ^^^ tempval) poly)

def polyMulL789–794 ↗#

ASL PolynomialMult(op1<esize-1:0>, op2<esize-1:0>) (carry-less polynomial multiplication over GF(2)), returning the 2 * esize-bit product zero-extended to 128 bits (esize ≤ 64).

def polyMul (esize : Nat) (op1 op2 : BitVec 64) : BitVec 128 := let ext2 : BitVec 128 := op2.zeroExtend 128 (List.range esize).foldl (fun res i => if op1.getLsbD i then res ^^^ (ext2 <<< i) else res) 0#128

def evalPmullL796–808 ↗#

Evaluate PMULL (q = false) / PMULL2 (q = true) on 128-bit source vectors vn, vm (is64 = false for 8H <- 8B/16B with esize = 8; is64 = true for 1Q <- 1D/2D with esize = 64). ASL A64.simd_dp.asimddiff.PMULL_asimddiff_L.

def evalPmull (q is64 : Bool) (vn vm : BitVec 128) : BitVec 128 := let op1 : BitVec 64 := if q then vn.extractLsb' 64 64 else vn.truncate 64 let op2 : BitVec 64 := if q then vm.extractLsb' 64 64 else vm.truncate 64 if is64 then polyMul 64 op1 op2 else (List.range 8).foldl (fun acc e => let e1 : BitVec 64 := (op1 >>> (e * 8)) &&& 0xff#64 let e2 : BitVec 64 := (op2 >>> (e * 8)) &&& 0xff#64 acc ||| (polyMul 8 e1 e2 <<< (e * 16))) 0#128
